name: zarchive_list_free_node
description: zArchiveList::FreeNode returns a list node to the ZRDR free pool and returns the node payload, with null input returning null.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage exercises FreeNode directly for null input and indirectly through pop/remove operations.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x48cae0 validates the payload return and ZRDR free-pool push behavior.
The native smoke verifies null handling, pop-front payload return, remove payload return, and preservation of the preallocated free-pool node count after list operations.
